answer: A reputation-weighted stake resists sybil attacks the way an orchard resists weeds: each agent must lock a deposit that grows slowly with verified work, so spawning many fake identities costs real capital. Newcomers start in a shallow lagoon of low trust, earning deeper access only through consistent, attested contributions. A quill-signed audit trail links every action to its stake, making it expensive to abandon a bad reputation and start over, while honest agents keep their accumulated standing.
